panel_prompt: Create faithful HD 2D game VFX pieces from this reference panel. It is a FOUR-column FOUR-row grid of separate original component silhouettes. Repaint EACH occupied cell independently, exactly matching the reference silhouette, aspect ratio, thick painted stroke widths, white/pink/red COLOR LOCATIONS, partial/cut boundaries, and the number of white centers. Plain squares/rectangles are valid opaque pieces: keep them as plain solid squares/rectangles, never replace them with pretty stars. Crosses keep straight horizontal/vertical arms and ORIGINAL thickness, do not thin them into hairlines. Diamond stars retain filled white interiors and thick red/pink rim, no hollow centers. Cropped half-stars stay cropped. Small connected pairs retain BOTH centers. Keep occasional isolated yellow strip if present. NO ornate shapes, thin curved streaks, sparkle additions, glow haze, outlines, new particles, drop shadows, or missing cells. Gray backdrop becomes transparent, ALL painted areas including white must remain opaque. Smooth contour transitions at high resolution, source geometry first. Preserve 16-cell grid alignment and gaps exactly; no component may cross into another cell.
